description: This Python source file defines a logging configuration utility class 'LoggingConfigurator' that wraps around the standard 'logging' module to address setup/init issues and provides methods for configuring logging via files, console, and file sinks, including formatter style selection.

classes.name: LoggingConfigurator
classes.description: A class providing methods to configure Python's logging system with custom format styles and handling common setup issues.

methods.name: configure_by_file
methods.description: Configures logging using a configuration file and sets the logging level.

methods.name: configure_file_sink
methods.description: Sets up a file handler for logging with specified format and encoding.

methods.name: configure_console_sink
methods.description: Configures console logging, optionally applying format and date format.

methods.name: configure_level
methods.description: Sets the logging level for the root logger.

methods.name: make_formatter
methods.description: Creates a logging formatter with style based on the format string.

methods.name: select_format_style
methods.description: Determines the style ('%', '{', '$') for log message formatting based on the format string.
